input: Build a basic Notion dashboard for my week

gold.taskTitle: Build a Basic Notion Weekly Dashboard
gold.taskDescription: Set up a functional Notion dashboard that organises and displays the user's weekly information in one place.

questions.title: What is your primary use for this dashboard?
questions.description: Understand whether the dashboard is mainly for work, personal life, study, or a mix of all three.

questions.title: Which sections must the dashboard include?
questions.description: Identify the specific blocks the user wants, such as tasks, calendar, habits, notes, goals, or meal planning.

questions.title: Do you already have an existing Notion workspace set up?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a brand-new Notion account or an addition to an existing setup, which affects how the dashboard is structured.

questions.title: How do you want to view your weekly tasks?
questions.description: Find out whether the user prefers a timeline, kanban board, simple checklist, table, or calendar view for their tasks.

questions.title: Should the dashboard pull in data from other Notion databases?
questions.description: Clarify whether the dashboard needs to be linked to other existing Notion pages or databases the user already maintains.

questions.title: What does a successful week look like for you?
questions.description: Understand what outcomes or metrics the user wants to track so the dashboard can surface the most relevant information.

questions.title: How much time will you spend maintaining it each week?
questions.description: Gauge the user's commitment to upkeep so the dashboard complexity can be matched to a realistic maintenance routine.
